reason: With no car, getting to the Jbeil supermarkets means paying someone or a taxi, so a bag waiting at the mini-market in my village for $1.25 is easier. I would try the free first bag and keep going only if the receipt really matches.
objection: How do I know they really paid the cheap price and didn't add a markup? A slip is just paper, I want to see the till receipt matches what they say.
would_change_my_mind: A neighbour I know vouching for them, or seeing that the receipt and slip match on my first free bag. If one price is off, I stop.
